title: National Salvation Movement - Publication Entitled Friend

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY)
S.I., Special Branch: Station,
REPORT
Date October 5, 1938.
Subject "Friend", secret national salvation periodical, issue
No. 3, Vol. I, dated 12-9-38.
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by C. Gantola W.J.

Attached herewith is a copy of the Vol. I, issue
No. 3 of "Friend" ( 朋 友 ), a secret national salvation
publication, dated 12-9-38, in which no editorial address
is given. Its contents are briefly as follows :-
(1) Cartoon on the front page depicting a group of refugees
sitting next to a dilapidated building. The cartoon
bears the characters : "Return home to fight!".
(2) Commentary entitled "Return home and fight", urging that
unemployed workers should return to their native homes
to organize and train the masses in the country into
guerilla bands in order to harrass the Japanese army
and to preclude the possibility of any puppet organiza-
tions being formed by traitors.
(3) Article detailing the activities of Shanghai workers in
connection with the commemoration of the 1st anniversary
of the August 13th Incident.
(4) Article advocating the unification of the numerous labour
bodies under one head.
(5) Correspondence complaining of the high-handed policy and
oppressive attitude of the management of the Ford Hire
Service towards its chauffeurs and mechanics, especially
since the authority of the National Government was
curtailed as a result of the withdrawal of the Chinese
forces from the Shanghai area.
(6) Correspondence reporting on the generous contributions
toward the Refugee Relief Fund and the War Chest despite
the scanty amount wages of the people.
(7) Reproduction of a poem by General Feng Yu-hsiang, praising

报告
日期：1938年10月5日。
主题：“朋友”，秘密救国期刊，第一卷第三期，日期为1938年9月12日。
制作人：C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang 转交人：C. Gantola W.J.

随函附上秘密救国刊物《朋友》（Friend）第一卷第三期副本一份，日期为1938年9月12日，文中未提供编辑部地址。其内容简述如下：
(1) 头版漫画描绘了一群难民坐在一座破败的建筑物旁。漫画上写有字样：“回家去战斗！”
(2) 题为《回家去战斗》的评论文章，敦促失业工人返回家乡，组织和训练乡村民众组成游击队，以骚扰日军，并防止汉奸成立任何傀儡组织。
(3) 详细记述上海工人纪念“八一三”事变一周年活动的文章。
(4) 主张将众多劳工团体统一在一个领导之下的文章。
(5) 来信投诉福特租车行（Ford Hire Service）管理层对其司机和机械师采取的高压政策和压迫态度，特别是自中国军队撤出上海地区导致国民政府权威削弱以来。
(6) 来信报道，尽管民众工资微薄，但仍向难民救济基金和战时公债慷慨捐款。
(7) 转载冯玉祥将军的一首诗，赞扬

REPORT
Date August 10, 19 38.
Subject National Salvation Movement - publication entitled "Friend."
Made by Inspt. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by C. Gausden

Forwarded herewith is a copy of a publication
entitled "Friend" (朋友 ), inaugural issue, dated July
25, 1938, which purports to have emanated from the "Friend
Weekly Society" but no address is mentioned. The copy was
obtained by Special Branch detectives on August 9th.

This periodical which is of a national salvation
and anti-Japanese nature contains the following articles :-
1) Cartoon on the front page, depicting four hands
holding a man believed to represent a Japanese
soldier, with the Chinese inscription "Tighten your
grip".
2) Article entitled "Our views toward the People's
Political Council" expressing regrets that the above
Council did not select a representative from the
labouring classes to act as a member of the Council.
3) Article entitled "Hard Work performed by the Hankow
Iron Workers" eulogizing them in the work performed
in making big iron swords for the Chinese armies. It
states that the Hankow workers are willing to work
as hard as they do because they have a labour union
and the article advises the Shanghai workers to follow
suit.
4) Article entitled "Fires spreading over the Three
Eastern Provinces" describing how a number of arsenals,
aerodromes, power plants, gasoline tanks, etc. in
Mukden, Darin, Tsitsihar, etc., were set on fire by
some anti-war elements among the Japanese soldiers.
5) Article "Remarks by a postal worker about the July 7th
Anniversary" which states on the July 7th Anniversary,

报告
日期：1938年8月10日。
主题：救国运动——名为《朋友》的出版物。
制作人：Inspector Shih Ssu-chien 转交人：C. Gausden

现转呈名为《朋友》（Friend）的出版物创刊号副本一份，日期为1938年7月25日，声称出自“朋友周报社”，但未提及地址。该副本由特别股侦探于8月9日获取。

该期刊具有救国和反日性质，包含以下文章：
1) 头版漫画，描绘四只手抓住一名被认为是代表日本士兵的男子，中文题字为“抓紧”。
2) 题为《我们对国民参政会的看法》的文章，对国民参政会未从劳工阶级中选拔代表担任参议员表示遗憾。
3) 题为《汉口铁工人的艰苦工作》的文章，颂扬他们为中国军队制造大刀所做的工作。文章指出，汉口工人之所以愿意如此努力工作，是因为他们有工会，并建议上海工人效仿。
4) 题为《东三省蔓延的大火》的文章，描述沈阳、大连（原文为Darin，疑为Dalian之误）、齐齐哈尔等地的兵工厂、机场、发电厂、汽油库等如何被日军中的部分反战分子纵火焚烧。
5) 《一位邮政工人关于七七纪念日的感言》一文，指出在七七纪念日，

Government's war chest.

6) Article "Commemoration of July 7th Anniversary by
Various Mill Workers", giving the following summaries:-
   a) About 500 workers of the XX Cotton Mill, a
      British concern, contributed funds, and a number
      of them observed the "Silence Ceremony" during
      noon on that day.
   b) Several workers attached to the XX Cotton Mill
      gave lectures to their fellow-workers regarding
      the political, military and economical movements
      in the past year, and the future of the current
      war of resistance.
   c) The Chung Hwa Book Company held a meeting in
      commemoration of the July 7th Anniversary, in
      which 57 staff members attended.

7) Article entitled "Soliciting articles in commemoration
of the August 13th Anniversary" asking the public to
contribute articles on the subject "My life during
the past year" in order to commemorate the forthcoming
August 13th Anniversary.

（印：RECEIVED 11.8.39 SHANGHAI）

全体邮政员工发起了一场捐款运动，成功筹集了400元，用于救济难民和支持政府战时公债。

6) 《各厂工人纪念七七周年》一文，摘要如下：
   a) 某英商棉纺厂（XX Cotton Mill）约500名工人捐款，其中许多人在当天中午举行了“静默仪式”。
   b) 隶属于该棉纺厂（XX Cotton Mill）的几名工人向同事讲解了过去一年的政治、军事和经济动态，以及当前抗战的未来前景。
   c) 中华书局举行会议纪念七七周年，共有57名职员出席。

7) 题为《征求纪念八一三周年稿件》的文章，呼吁公众以“我过去一年的生活”为主题投稿，以纪念即将到来的八一三周年。

（印：1939年8月11日 上海 收讫）
